name: High-Protein Banana Bread Baked Oats
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and lightly grease a square 20cm x 20cm baking tin with a small knob of plant based butter.
Combine the flaxseed and 50ml water in a bowl and mix well. Set aside for 10 mins to form a slurry (this will act as an egg substitute).
Meanwhile, mash ⅔ of the bananas directly in the baking tin. Slice the third banana and set it aside.

Add the oats, protein powder, baking powder, cinnamon and a pinch of salt to the baking tin. Mix until well combined. Pour the soy milk, vanilla extract and flaxseed slurry into the oat mixture, then stir until everything is fully combined.

Roughly chop the dark chocolate and scatter it over the top of the mixture, along with the reserved banana slices. Bake for 30 mins or until the top is golden brown. Let it cool completely before slicing.
Serve slightly warm, with some plant-based high-protein yoghurt, fresh berries, a drizzle of maple syrup.
